duplication_audit.preserved_no_go: no shared global component voting, component-only shift MLP, isolated rendered-component population atlas, or size/confidence purity rule
duplication_audit.material_distinction: each frozen decoder component is rendered at native 20px tile resolution with raw and per-tile-normalized pixels, jointly conditioned on the permutation-equivariant set of all current-board components, scored by a separately supervised exact-purity head, and may independently anchor at most one strict packed layout

training.supervision: balanced exact-component purity BCE on every nontrivial component plus size-weighted feasible joint-offset CE only on exact-pure components
training.paired_corruption_consistency: smooth-L1 purity probability plus squared joint-offset probability distance only for components aligned by train-only true member positions and identical relative geometry

calibration.threshold_rule: among observed board-top purity-times-offset-confidence scores selecting at least four boards, maximize signed anchored-component size utility per 32 boards, then precision, threshold, and sparsity; require positive utility and precision at least 0.25 or force fallback-only threshold 1.000001

inference.selection_score: sigmoid exact-purity logit times maximum feasible joint-offset softmax probability
inference.anchor_operation: place the selected original-upright decoder component at its one predicted feasible absolute offset
inference.packing: retain noncolliding baseline-rigid components, place collided components at feasible minimum baseline L1 displacement, then Hungarian-fill unresolved original upright tiles
inference.fallback_if_no_anchor: frozen raw d64 decoder144 plus frozen cyclic-border5
inference.comparator: frozen raw d64 decoder144 plus frozen cyclic-border5

discovery_gate.policy: all of purity AP at least 2x the strongest prevalence/inverse-size/accepted-edge-confidence baseline, exact at least +0.25 tile per board, adjacency loss at most 0.2 percentage point, and 32 strict original-tile permutations
